blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY — Batanes lone district Rep. Ciriaco Gato Jr. died on Monday, Sept. 21, due to cardiac arrest. He was 66. Gato’s relatives and friends confirmed his death, saying he died while being taken to a hospital in Manila. READ: Batanes solon disputes Chinese claim: Ivatans are Filipinos Fr. Rolando Berber Manabat, rector parish priest of the Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception-Batanes, asked the public to pray for Gato’s eternal repose. “In your charity, please pray for the eternal repose of the soul of (Representative Gato),” Manabat posted on Facebook.
